title: Take-Home: A Four-Hour Exploratory ML Study
summary: A self-contained 4-hour take-home: implement a small classifier, then run a grid over symmetric label noise, training-set size, and hidden-layer width on synthetic data to see whether early stopping against a clean validation set recovers the accuracy the noise destroys.
rubric: Data and model: how the noisy labels are made, the one-hidden-layer classifier, and what is held clean
Grid: noise rate against training-set size and hidden width, with repeats and error bars
Early stopping: how much of the noise damage a small clean validation set recovers, and where it does not
Interpretation: which conclusions the data supports and which it does not
Limits and next steps: what you would change with more time, and why
Presentation: the result first, in ten minutes, with the plots that carry it
